justifications.durability: the new AST guard is a strong, non-vacuous instrument: it walks every module under imas_codex, validates the first argument of get_model/get_model_config/get_reasoning_effort, the section argument of llm_health_check/llm_deep_health_check, and `section`/`model_section` keyword arguments, parameter defaults and dataclass fields; it carries a positive control asserting the walk sees at least one live seat reference (so a truncated scan cannot read as clean); and its negative control reddens on the exact regression it guards (proved by this review). Docked one point because the batch-size section-source move is not pinned: get_labeling_batch_size moved from reading `[language].batch-size` to `[cluster-labels].batch-size` (settings.py:1164), but the two batch-size tests (test_get_labeling_batch_size_env_override, test_get_labeling_batch_size_default) pass regardless of which section is read — the two values are both 50 today — so a reversion to the retired key would be silent, and the AST guard does not cover `_get_section(...)` arguments. The seat reference in get_model("cluster-labels") is guarded, but the batch-size read is not.
justifications.evidence: the invariant is measured and independently reproduced by this review. The head arm the run names (gate-retire-language-seat-2.log, revision 5554fa5e9) exits 0 at 2608 passed, 7 skipped; the superseded arm (gate-retire-language-seat.log) is also green. Docked one point: the run's own gate-arm provenance is imperfect — gate-retire-language-seat.log declares `# revision: ba4dda34…` (the base) but its run included tests/core/test_model_seat_names.py, which does not exist at ba4dda34 and is new in this node, so the header revision mislabels a run made against the uncommitted head; and the arm the manifest names as latest ran at 5554fa5e9, one commit before the final head 4d30baabd. Neither changes the conclusion (both arms have zero failures), but a revision header that does not name the tree the run resolved is the one fact a later reader cannot check.
justifications.fit: names are capability-based and mechanism-named throughout — discovery-triage, discovery-score, discovery-describe, discovery-vision, cluster-labels, ids-mapping; the test uses `_live_config_sections`, `_string_constants`, `_default_strings`, `_collect_references`, `_SEAT_FIRST_ARG`. No plan label, sprint id, ticket reference or author attribution appears in source, tests or the evidence fragment. All three commit messages carry a substantive body and no AI trailer (verified with a line-anchored grep).
